content.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About The Strategic Finance Team

Zipline’s Strategic Finance team sits at the center of the company’s commercial strategy, partnering closely with Go-to-Market, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to guide critical decisions and build the financial foundation for scale.

The team drives pricing, forecasting, partner deal structuring, user and partner economics, and scenario planning across both core revenue channels and emerging products like Zipline Marketplace.

Blending analytical rigor with cross-functional influence and an entrepreneurial mindset, Strategic Finance uncovers growth opportunities, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term business value. The team is based at Zipline’s South San Francisco headquarters in an in-person/hybrid environment.

The Role

As a Strategic Finance Intern supporting Operations Finance, you will play a key role in helping Zipline understand and optimize the financial performance of our global operations. You’ll work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Data teams to build analyses, streamline reporting, and develop insights that directly influence strategic and operational decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who loves solving complex problems, is comfortable with data, and wants hands-on exposure to how a hardware-enabled, technology-driven business operates.

What You'll Do

Support Operations Finance with metric development, reporting, forecasting, and financial modelingQuery and analyze large operational datasets using SQL (Snowflake experience a plus)Build repeatable dashboards and tools in Excel, Google Sheets, and BI platforms to drive visibility into performancePartner with operations leaders to understand drivers of cost, efficiency, and performance across global sitesSupport ad-hoc analyses related to operational efficiency, unit economics, and scaling strategiesAssist in month-end processes, variance analysis, and KPI reviewsContribute to cross-functional initiatives involving Supply Chain, Product, and Data teamsHelp improve internal processes by identifying gaps and implementing simple automation or workflow improvements


What You'll Bring

A strong analytical mindset with comfort getting into the details and understanding how complex operations functionExperience with SQL, relational databases, and working with large datasets (Snowflake preferred; experience with dbt or modern data stacks is a plus)High proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets; ability to build and manage structured and dynamic financial modelsStrong communication skills—comfortable interacting with cross-functional partners who have diverse backgrounds and perspectivesAbility to work with imperfect information and drive clarity in a fast-paced environmentStrong organizational skills and a desire to create processes that bring structure and accountabilityInterest in hardware-focused or technology-enabled businesses; experience in technology, healthcare devices, or operations-heavy industries is a plusKnowledge of financial statements, accounting fundamentals, and core financial analysis concepts (e.g., unit economics, scenario analysis, return on capital)A “general athlete” mentality—eager to jump into a wide variety of problems and learn quicklyPrior experience in operational finance, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or analytics is a plus, but not required


What Else You Should Know

This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May/June to August/September. Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.

Candidates are limited to three (3) applications within a 30-day period.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process.

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

About You And The Role

Zipline is seeking a Manufacturing Finance Partner to join our Strategic Finance team to help make manufacturing performance measurable, explainable, and economically actionable as we prepare for hyperscale. As manufacturing expands rapidly over the coming years, this role will help build the financial operating lens needed to scale with that growth. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys translating operational reality into financial insight. You will partner closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Accounting to establish cost truth, improve inventory and cash visibility, create actionable variance analysis, and build the reporting cadence that helps leaders make sharper scaling decisions. You will be successful here if you can thrive in a fast-changing manufacturing environment while knowing what great looks like in the future. The work is not just reporting the numbers; it is helping lead the team from evolving systems and processes toward a scaled operating model with clear ownership, reliable data, and decision-quality economics.

What You'll Do

Own manufacturing finance reporting, forecasting, and variance analysis across cost, labor, inventory, cash, and operating expense.Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Accounting to understand performance drivers and turn them into clear business actions.Build financial models and decision support for product cost, production planning, capacity, cost-down initiatives, make-buy analysis, and manufacturing investments.Develop dashboards, reporting, and operating cadences that give leaders better visibility into manufacturing performance and unit economics.Analyze key operational drivers such as labor efficiency, material usage, rework, scrap, yield, throughput, WIP, E&O, and production volume.Improve the data, systems, and processes that support scalable manufacturing finance, including ERP, inventory, and operational reporting workflows.


What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.Approximately 3+ years of experience in Manufacturing Finance, FP&A, OperationsFinance, Cost Accounting, Supply Chain Finance, or another analytical finance role.Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial statements, and operational performance drivers.Experience analyzing manufacturing, hardware, supply chain, inventory, or other operational cost drivers.Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modeling and scenario analysis.Experience working with ERP, MRP, MES, inventory, or operational data systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Zerp, or similar tools.Ability to work with large datasets, identify the business drivers behind the numbers, and communicate findings clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.Strong problem-solving skills, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively when processes and data are still evolving.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in high-growth hardware, aerospace, robotics, automotive, consumer electronics, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex operational environments.Familiarity with SQL, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics and business intelligence tools.Experience with inventory analysis, WIP, E&O, cycle counts, rework, scrap, yield, throughput, or capacity planning.Experience supporting manufacturing cost reduction, product cost modeling, make-buy decisions, or supplier cost analysis.Familiarity with standard costing, expected cost models, BOM governance, or cost accounting concepts.Experience partnering with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Accounting, and systems teams.Passion for building scalable processes, improving data quality, and turning ambiguity into operating clarity.


You'll Be Successful If You 

Enjoy understanding how products are built and how operational decisions affect cost, throughput, and cash.Naturally ask "why" when performance moves, and can separate symptoms from root causes.Can distinguish factory-owned execution from upstream design, supplier, quality, or launch-related drivers.Build strong relationships across Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Accounting.Can independently investigate messy operational data and turn it into practical recommendations.Balance analytical rigor with business judgment and a bias toward action.Thrive in environments where the right answer requires building the model, improving the process, and tightening the data at the same time.Take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to make recurring finance processes more scalable.


What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

Zipline is looking for a driven and detail-oriented Accounting Intern to join our Finance & Accounting team. This is a hands-on internship where you’ll learn the building blocks of corporate accounting in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. You’ll support the team with financial operations, assist with month-end close, and help ensure our systems and records stay sharp and audit-ready.

This internship is perfect for someone who wants to explore what it’s like to be an in-house accountant at a global, high-growth tech company—and who’s excited to dig into the details of autonomous drone delivery!

What You'll Do

Assist in core accounting processes including preparing journal entries, reconciling accounts, and maintaining accurate records.Support the monthly and quarterly financial close by compiling data, running reports, and preparing schedules.Learn how Zipline’s finance systems work, and support data entry, analysis, and cleanup projects.Partner with our country operations and manufacturing teams to support fixed asset accounting activities, including asset tracking, capitalization, and reconciliation.Collaborate with the broader Finance, Procurement, and Operations teams to track transactions and streamline processes.Learn about international accounting operations and get exposure to Zipline’s global footprint.


What You'll Bring

You must have completed the second year of your undergraduate studies in Accounting. Masters and PhDs are also eligible. You’re organized, detail-oriented, and not afraid of spreadsheets.You’re comfortable working with numbers and eager to apply what you’ve learned in school to real-world work.Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets (bonus if you’ve used formulas or pivot tables!)Passion for Zipline’s mission and a curiosity about accounting in a global tech startup.You ask good questions and enjoy problem-solving.You’re reliable, resourceful, and motivated to learn by doing.You care about Zipline’s mission and want to understand how finance can support global operations at scale.
